text: Entry Requirements 1.Non-Chinese citizens 2.17-25 years old (Applicants under 18 should provide certificate of guardian who has Nanjing residency.) 3.Senior-high graduates or above 4.English-taught program: IELTS (6.0 or above), TOEFL (80 or above) or equivalent English proficiency letter. 5.CSCA subjects requirements: Engineering programs: Mathematics and Physics, both in English. Business program: Mathematics, in English.
